text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... What an adorable little doll
you are! It
seems I've fallen for you at
first sight!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Blond hair and eyes like those on the
wings of a
morpho butterfly... Ah, you're
just so entrancing!

text_block_list.name: Doll Shop Staff
text_block_list.text:
She really is beautiful, isn't she?
Unfortunately,
though, another customer
arranged to take her
home just a few
moments ago...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I see. So she's been sold, yes? I
suppose with
a lovely doll like you, it
was just a matter of time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. It seems it wasn't meant to be,
but I wish
you happiness.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Unable to take home the doll she fell in
love with,
a disheartened Mejiro Bright
leaves the shop.
